data.description:
## Observation
`capabilities._capabilities_from_profile` classifies every profile exposing `bedrock_supports_prompt_caching` as `prompt_cache_style="bedrock"`, whatever that flag's value. So `cache_settings_for` returns Bedrock cache settings for amazon.nova, mistral and cohere (and, after garlicky-leery-seal, meta and unknown vendors), and `runner.py` passes `caching_requested=cache_settings is not None` to `cache_diagnostics.warn_if_cache_ineffective`.
pydantic-ai 1.107.9 applies those settings only when the profile's `bedrock_supports_prompt_caching`/`bedrock_supports_tool_caching` is True (models/bedrock.py 894-895, 1102-1103, 1117-1118), which is False for those vendors. So no cache point is sent, both cache counters are 0, and any call with input at or above the cache floor logs "prompt caching requested ... but had NO effect" although caching was never possible. The warning is false and tells the operator to act on nothing.
Measured: classification for nova-pro, mistral-large, cohere command-r and (with the fix) Llama 4 Maverick is `bedrock` with `bedrock_supports_prompt_caching=False`. The warning firing on a live call was not observed; the conclusion is from the code path.
Found while fixing garlicky-leery-seal.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A Bedrock model whose profile has `bedrock_supports_prompt_caching=False` produces no cache-ineffective warning, shown by a test.
- [ ] A caching Bedrock model with both counters at 0 above the floor still warns.
data.title: Cache-ineffective warning fires on Bedrock vendors that have no prompt caching
